description: Score candidate edits by exact per-pair slack against the verifier rather than by approximate bad-book counts. The goal is to align search pressure with the yes/no witness certificate.
mathematical_formalization: slack(u,v)=min((n-2)-cn_G(u,v), (n-1)-cn_\overline{G}(u,v)) with sign conditioned on edge/non-edge status.
implementation_hypothesis: Maintain exact slack histograms and improve the minimum slack first on hard unsupported instances.
experiment_seed: Benchmark on n in {22,24,50} against surrogate bad-book objectives.

closest_prior_art.title: Lower bounds for book Ramsey numbers
Quantum Based Grover's Algorithm and Graph Coloring in Unstructured Searches for Bit String Validation

novelty_claim: The novelty is objective-function alignment with the exact verifier rather than stochastic score hacking.
differentiation: The cited search-style work is about finding valid states; this idea is specifically about reparameterizing local search around verifier slack.
